name: LTspice
install: Download from Analog Devices. Run installer and launch LTspice.exe. No account required.
best_for: SPICE transient, AC, DC sweep, Bode plots, switching supplies

name: ngspice
install: Install from package manager or prebuilt binaries. Run from terminal.
best_for: Batch simulations, scripted sweeps, integration with Python

name: KiCad
install: Download installer from kicad.org and install with default options.
best_for: Schematic capture, PCB routing, spice co-simulation

name: Qucs-S
install: Install Qucs-S package, then configure ngspice or Xyce backend in settings.
best_for: Schematic-first simulation with multiple solver backends

name: GNU Octave
install: Install from official installer. Optional packages can be installed from Forge.
best_for: Control systems, signal analysis, MATLAB-compatible scripts

name: Arduino IDE
install: Install from arduino.cc. Select board package and COM port from Tools menu.
best_for: PWM control, sensor prototypes, quick microcontroller projects

name: Fritzing
install: Download package and run installer. Use parts library for visual wiring docs.

name: PlatformIO
install: Install VS Code extension or pip install platformio for CLI usage.
best_for: Professional embedded builds, libraries, CI for firmware
